description: Offline AI text-to-speech desktop app with natural voices and local speech synthesis.
notes: Installation uses the official NSIS setup in silent mode with /S and directs it to the Scoop version directory with /D=$dir. NSIS requires /D to be the final argument and the path must not be quoted.

The upstream NSIS customInstall routine extracts vc_redist.x64.exe and silently installs the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable required by onnxruntime-node. This is a real vendor installation step and may require elevation; the runtime is not removed during Scoop uninstall because it is shared by other applications.

The Windows GitHub Actions extraction test (run 41455667327) verified the setup SHA-256 and confirmed the app payload is packaged inside $PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z. This manifest now uses the vendor installer rather than archive extraction. Keep it under review until the silent install path and uninstaller have been exercised through Scoop on a clean Windows runner.
